Setup.Name: Parsing logs with dissect
Setup.Description: A simple log parser that will use the dissect parser to process a log message.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Server logs"
    Description: "Collect all log messages from the server."
    Mqtt:
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/log"
    Otel:
      Attributes:
        - Key: Location
          Value: MainServerRoom
      Logs:
        - PayloadType: Json
          Transform: "DISSECT('%{otel_timestamp} [%{otel_loglevel}] [%{server_name}] %{otel_message}')"
